home.title: JurrSelf — Get out of your head. Get into your body.
home.description: Experience what happens when your body comes under pressure. Breathwork, ice bath and physical training in Javea, guided by Jurriaan.

hero.alt: Jurriaan during a session at sunset in Javea
hero.subtitle: Experience what happens when your body comes under pressure. Learn to recognise the signals. Learn to use them.

why.title:
PRESSURE REVEALS.
YOUR BODY KNOWS FIRST.
why.text: People spend too much time in their heads. JurrSelf brings you back to your body, through physical effort, breathing and cold. Not to talk about stress. To feel what is actually happening. Recognise. Steer.

split.title:
Don’t think it.
Feel it.
split.text: Breathing. Tension. Control. Restlessness. Relaxation. Experience first. Then recognise. Then learn to steer, not as theory, but as a body that shows it to you itself.

offer.title: Offer — JurrSelf
offer.description: Two forms, one way in: breathwork and ice bath, or functional 1-on-1 physical training. Discover the JurrSelf Experience and Programme.

adem.title: Breath + Ice
adem.p1: A guided breathwork session followed by exposure to cold in an ice bath. Not as a challenge. Not to prove how strong you are.
adem.p2: You observe what happens in your body when tension arises: breathing, tension, control, restlessness, relaxation.

fysiek.title: Physical Training
fysiek.p1: Functional 1-on-1 training: sandbags, sled, your own body weight, natural movement, physical resistance.
fysiek.p2: Fatigue and resistance are used deliberately. Under pressure, automatic reactions become visible, and you learn to recognise them.

principle.title: Flow, Fight, Flight, Freeze
principle.text: Experience first. Then recognise. Then learn to steer. You go home with concrete signals and tools, usable outside the session too. The goal is not to become dependent on a coach. The goal is to learn to observe and steer yourself better.

science.title: The science behind the experience
science.lead: Breathwork and cold are not trends. They are ways to train your nervous system, backed by research into stress regulation and recovery.

cards.title: Breathing
cards.text: Conscious breathing activates the vagus nerve, the main nerve of your rest system. It slows your heart rate and helps your body switch faster between tension and relaxation.

cards.title: Cold exposure
cards.text: Short, controlled exposure to cold trains your stress response. You learn to stay calm while your body sounds the alarm, a skill that carries over to high-pressure moments in daily life.

cards.title: Physical load
cards.text: Heavy, functional effort brings automatic reactions to the surface: flight, fight, freeze. Under guidance you learn to recognise and adjust those patterns.

about.title: About me — JurrSelf
about.description: Jurriaan guides the JurrSelf experience: no gym, no wellness concept, no traditional coaching. The body as the way in.

hero.alt: Jurriaan by the coast in Javea
hero.title: Jurriaan

intro.title: No gym, no wellness concept, no traditional coaching.
p: I believe people spend too much time in their heads. Not because they are stuck, they often function perfectly well. But there is more to gain from contact with your own body.
With JurrSelf I use the body as the way in: physical effort, breathing and cold make it tangible what happens once pressure arises. I guide that experience, I am not on stage.
The goal is not that you become dependent on me. The goal is that you learn to observe and steer yourself better, with tools you can use anywhere.

items.q: Do I need to be fit to take part?
items.a: No. The intensity adapts to your level. It is not about performance, but about experiencing what happens in your body.
Swimwear, a towel and warm clothes for afterwards. The rest, such as breathwork equipment and the ice bath, is provided.

items.q: Is this safe with a heart condition or during pregnancy?
items.a: Always consult your doctor first. Breathwork and cold exposure are intense for the body and not suitable for everyone without consultation.

items.q: Where does the session take place?
items.a: At a private location in Javea. You will receive the exact address personally after booking.

items.q: What is the difference between the Experience and the Programme?
items.a: The Experience is one intensive session to get acquainted. The Programme is five sessions for those who truly want to learn to recognise and apply the principles.

privacy.title: Privacy — JurrSelf
privacy.description: How JurrSelf handles your data and cookies.
privacy.heading:
This is how we handle
your data.

p: JurrSelf, Javea (Spain). Questions about your data? Email {email}.
If you contact us via the form, WhatsApp or email, we receive your name, contact details and message. In addition, only with your consent, we measure how the website is used (see Cookies).
Only to respond to your enquiry or booking, and to improve the website. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.
We keep contact details no longer than necessary to handle your enquiry or booking, with a maximum of 2 years after the last contact, unless the law requires a longer period.

Necessary storage (your cookie choice) is always active. Statistics (Google Analytics, loaded via Google Tag Manager) are off by default and only switch on if you click Accept. We then measure, for example, which pages are visited and whether an email, phone or WhatsApp link is used. We do not use advertising or marketing cookies.

Accepting and Rejecting are equally easy, and rejecting has no effect on your use of the website. Your choice is stored on your device for 6 months; after that we ask again. You can change or withdraw it at any time via Cookie settings at the bottom of the page. Google may process data outside the EU; Google LLC falls under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

We process data from the form or email on the basis of our legitimate interest in answering your question and carrying out an assignment. We process statistics only on the basis of your consent, which you can withdraw at any time. Data may be processed by our hosting provider (Vercel), our email service (mijn.host) and, only with your consent, Google (Analytics and Tag Manager). Data processing agreements or standard terms apply with these parties.

You can request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, object to processing, and withdraw consent you gave earlier. Email {email}; we respond within 30 days. You may also file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority or the Spanish regulator ({aepd}).
